LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_I.label: solar fluid simulation array
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_I.description: Increases research speed when placed near hi-tech research bench and unlocks Solarite research projects. Each research bench can only use one solar fluid simulation array.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_II.label: sigma-class sagittary autoscope
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_II.description: Increases research speed when placed near a hi-tech research bench, additionally unlocking kwazaari research projects. Each research bench can only use one sigma-class sagittary autoscope.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_III.label: dark mirror
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_III.description: Increases research speed when placed near hi-tech research bench and unlocks tenebral research projects. Each research bench can only peer into one dark mirror.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_IV.label: umbral spire
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_IV.description: Increases research speed when placed near hi-tech research bench and unlocks Umbral research projects. Each research bench can only entreat one Umbral spire.
